description: Schema-v1 scrobble. This ID is fixture-only; production requires an owner-controlled prefix.

main.description: A completed listen asserted by its author. Each record counts once; repeated tracks at equal times are valid.

artist.description: One credited display string; raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming. The scalar limit is enforced by the validator.

track.description: Raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

album.description: If present, raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

listenedAt.description: Explicit UTC RFC3339, from 1970-01-01 through event receipt time plus 300 seconds inclusive.

createdAt.description: Explicit UTC RFC3339, from 1970-01-01 through event receipt time plus 300 seconds inclusive.

recordingMbid.description: Optional unverified recording UUID; runtime validates UUID syntax. Not a grouping key.
